system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform action: Sends OTP for PMKSY irrigation authentication. Here are my details: my mobile_number is 9876598227, my aadhaar_number is 100020009936.

function.name: pmksy_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for PMKSY irrigation authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

function.name: pmksy_select_irrigation_type
function.description: Selects an irrigation type for the application. Returns system details, subsidy rates, and requirements. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if type unsupported or incompatible with land/crop.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
